intro: Cape Verde is a chain of volcanic islands in the Atlantic that was uninhabited until the Portuguese arrived in the 1400s.

chapters.title: Settlement
text: Portuguese settlers arrived around 1462 and founded Cidade Velha, the first European colonial town in the tropics. The islands became a hub of the Atlantic slave trade.
A Creole people and culture grew from mixing Portuguese and African roots.

chapters.title: Drought and migration
text: Droughts caused terrible famines, and many Cape Verdeans emigrated, especially to the United States and Portugal. Today more Cape Verdeans live abroad than at home.

chapters.title: Independence
text: Cape Verde fought alongside Guinea-Bissau for independence and became independent in 1975. Since 1991 it has been a stable multi-party democracy.

keyTerms.meaning: A culture and language formed from mixing.
